# Cybercon Solutions

> Managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud, and AI for South Florida businesses and nonprofits with roughly 15–150 employees. Founder-led, based in Cooper City, Florida. We catch issues early and treat security as the baseline.

Cybercon Solutions LLC serves Cooper City, Davie, and Broward County, Florida, onsite and remote, in English and Spanish. Contact: info@cybercon-solutions.com · (754) 300-9786. Legal mailing address (no customer visits): 407 Lincoln Rd. Suite 6H PMB 7209, Miami Beach, FL 33139.

Every page listed here has a Markdown version: swap the page path for `/md/<path>.md` (for example https://cybercon-solutions.com/md/services/managed-it.md; the homepage is https://cybercon-solutions.com/md/index.md). Each HTML page also links its Markdown version with `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`.

## About

- [Founder: Yezid Acosta](https://cybercon-solutions.com/about/): CIO/CISO and Founder; 25+ years leading security, infrastructure, cloud, compliance, and IT operations. Engagements are founder-led.

## Pricing

- Managed IT: flat per-user monthly packages, no per-incident trip charges. Dollar figures are quoted after a free assessment and are not published. Details: https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/managed-it/
- [Web Design & Development](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/web-design-development/): Essential website $750 (fixed price); Growth website from $1,150; custom web projects scoped and quoted.
- [Free IT cost & risk assessment](https://cybercon-solutions.com/assessment/): no-cost starting point; a real engineer replies within one business day.

## Services

- [Managed IT Services](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/managed-it/): Help desk, monitoring, patching, and onsite support
- [Cybersecurity & Compliance](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/cybersecurity/): EDR/XDR, SOC, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA
- [AI Security](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/ai-security/): AI tool governance, data-leakage prevention, workspace security
- [Cloud Services & Architecture](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/cloud/): Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Entra ID
- [IT Consulting & Strategic Leadership](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/it-consulting/): vCIO, roadmaps, risk, budgets, QBRs
- [Backup & Disaster Recovery](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/backup-disaster-recovery/): Backups, replication, recovery validation
- [AI Consulting & Strategy](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/ai-consulting/): Practical AI roadmaps and ROI assessment
- [AI Integration & Automation](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/ai-integration/): Connect AI to ERP, CRM, and existing stack
- [Conversational AI & Voice](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/conversational-ai/): Chatbots and AI voice systems
- [Web Design & Development](https://cybercon-solutions.com/services/web-design-development/): Fixed-scope websites and custom web projects
